Job Summary Job Summary As a key player in our engineering team, you will design and develop new features for our primary i OS & Android products, which are part of a comprehensive, multi-tenant Saa S solution on AWS. We are seeking a flexible, self-motivated, and hands-on senior programmer with a passion for creating excellent code and a great user experience. You will collaborate closely with Product Management and field professionals to turn diverse requirements into actionable plans. This role offers a unique opportunity to observe the large-scale deployment and usage of our product by enterprise customers. Key Responsibilities Provide technical leadership in the development and maintenance of our i OS and Android solutions. Ensure the best possible performance, quality, and responsiveness of the mobile applications. Collaborate with Product Management to analyze requirements and contribute to the product roadmap. Work with other developers and disciplines, including support, to meet product goals. Drive and oversee the development lifecycle from prototyping and implementation to testing and maintenance. Define and evangelize best practices with a focus on code robustness, security, performance, and scalability. Diagnose and fix product issues, interfacing with the Support team to handle customer escalations. Qualifications Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent work experience. 5+ years of software development experience with a Bachelor's degree. 3+ years of experience developing on the i OS platform. Strong background in OOP languages such as Swift, Objective-C, Java, or C#. Excellent understanding of Swift, Objective-C, and programming concepts like multithreading, MVC, MVVM, and unit testing. Excellent understanding of i OS frameworks, the Android OS, and their respective ecosystems. Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills. Preferred Qualifications Knowledge of Kotlin. Experience with cloud platforms like AWS or Azure (Paa S/Iaa S). Experience with test automation frameworks such as Appium, XCTest, or Espresso. Understanding of CI/CD concepts, GIT workflows, and associated tools. Knowledge of security concepts (certificates, tokens, OAuth) and identity management. Experience in full-stack web development. Job Summary Job Summary We are seeking a hands-on Senior Android Software Engineer who possesses in-depth knowledge of the Android ecosystem, a passion for security-first development, and a strong product commitment. In this role, you will be a key player in designing, developing, and securing new features for our primary Android mobile products. Key Responsibilities Technical Leadership: Drive the architecture, implementation, and maintenance of our core Android solutions, ensuring high performance, quality, and responsiveness. End-to-End Ownership: Oversee the development lifecycle from prototyping and implementation to testing, delivery, and ongoing maintenance. Security & Best Practices: Define and evangelize development best practices with a strict focus on code robustness, mobile security, scalability, and performance. Collaboration & Alignment: Work closely with Product Management, Sales, UX designers, and backend engineering teams to align on product roadmaps and backend API design. Customer & Field Support: Interface with Support and field teams to diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve complex customer escalations in large-scale enterprise deployments. Mentorship: Lead brainstorming and design sessions, providing ongoing technical direction and code reviews for teammates across multiple global sites. Innovation: Stay ahead of the curve regarding evolving mobile technologies, Android OS updates, and relevant open-source libraries. Qualifications Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 5+ years of professional software development experience, with 3+ years dedicated to the Android platform and at least 2 years in a technical leadership or lead role. Strong proficiency in Kotlin and Java, alongside a deep understanding of core Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) concepts. Deep understanding of modern Android architecture patterns (MVVM, MVI, MVP) and UI patterns (including Material Design). Strong understanding of multithreading, concurrency, and asynchronous programming concepts. Experience with Android testing frameworks (Espresso, JUnit) and a solid understanding of Git workflows and CI/CD pipelines. Proven knowledge of code signing and distributing applications through the Google Play Store, as well as managing dependencies via Maven/Gradle. Solid understanding of Identity and Access Management (IAM) concepts, including OAuth 2.0, Open ID Connect (OIDC), SCIM, and token-based authentication. Familiarity with user directory concepts like Active Directory, user groups, authentication/authorization mechanisms, and security policies. Understanding of Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), PKI, certificate security, encryption, and secure data storage on mobile devices. Basic understanding or experience with cloud platforms, preferably Amazon Web Services (AWS) or Microsoft Azure (Iaa S/Paa S). Understanding of no-schema (No SQL) databases and local mobile data persistence. Preferred Qualifications Basic understanding of i OS development (Swift, Objective-C, XCTest) is a strong plus to help collaborate on cross-platform mobile initiatives. Working experience with Mobile Device Management (MDM) or Mobile Application Management (MAM) policies. Experience or interest in full-stack web development, Windows programming, or kernel-mode development. Exposure to global security compliance and privacy frameworks (e.g., GDPR, SOX, PII, and PHI data handling). Experience working in a fast-paced Agile/Scrum environment across geographically distributed teams. Job Summary As a Customer Success Engineer (CSE) at Palo Alto Networks, you will be a key Idira(previously Cyber Ark) technical specialist within our Customer Success organization. You will bridge the gap between technical implementation and business value, acting as an on-demand technical expert to guide deployments, support integrations, and drive customer satisfaction. Leveraging your expert product knowledge and consultative skills, you will ensure a seamless onboarding experience and accelerate time-to-value for our customers. You will collaborate closely with Onboarding Customer Success Managers, Sales, and Product Management to solve complex technical challenges and advocate for the customer’s technical needs internally. Onboarding & Adoption: Assist Onboarding CSM to guide new customers through the initial stages of their product journey, orchestrating technical milestones to ensure a smooth transition and early value realization. Strategic Technical Advisory: Conduct Palo Alto Networks Blueprint sessions to align Identity Security best practices with the customer’s unique business and security outcomes. Consultative Guidance: Act as a trusted advisor, providing prescriptive recommendations tailored to risk, compliance, and security objectives. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Sales/Pre-Sales, and Channel teams to deliver a unified customer journey and serve as on demand technical advisor for existing customers that require targeted assistance. Customer Engagement: Lead technical workshops, and community engagement programs to deepen product usage and identify growth opportunities. Content Leadership: Develop educational content, including webinars, blogs, and "how-to" guides, for both technical and executive audiences. Voice of the Customer: Provide structured feedback to Product Management and Engineering to influence the product roadmap based on real-world customer usage and challenges. Qualifications

EDUCATION:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field. Professional Experience: 2–5 years of experience in a customer-facing technical role (e.g., Customer Success Engineering, Technical Support, or Solution Engineering). Hands-on experience with Windows/Active Directory administration, UNIX/Linux, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).Solid understanding of networking, application security, and the software development lifecycle. Familiarity with security frameworks such as Zero Trust, NIST, or CIS Controls. Soft Skills: Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for executive audiences. Strong problem-solving abilities and a proactive approach to mitigating technical risks. Excellent organizational and project management skills to handle multiple enterprise accounts simultaneously.
